eyebrow.zh: v0.3.0：offline 也听 --task · store 不再重复计行
eyebrow.en: v0.3.0: offline heeds --task too · store no longer duplicates rows

headline.zh:
你点名只测一道任务
offline 却把五道全跑了
headline.en:
You named one task to measure
offline ran all five instead

sub.zh: v0.3.0 之前，offline（默认）路径无视 --task——你 --task swe-bench-mini-001 只想测这一道，它却把 5 道 canonical 任务全跑了；--task 在 offline 模式下是个死选项（v0.2.0 只修了 online 那半）。现在 --task 在 online 和 offline 两条路径都一样穿透：点名哪道就只跑哪道。另一处：store 一直用追加模式写、读取不去重——每跑一遍 envelcost run，report/project 里就多出一整份重复行，文件也越积越大；现在 store 按 (task, harness) 去重替换、原子重写，report 永远只反映最新一次测算。
sub.en: Before v0.3.0 the offline (default) path ignored --task — you passed --task swe-bench-mini-001 to measure just that one, and it ran all 5 canonical tasks; --task was a dead option in offline mode (v0.2.0 only fixed the online half). Now --task threads through both the online and offline paths identically: name a task, only that one runs. Separately, the store always wrote in append mode and never de-duplicated on read — every envelcost run added a full duplicate set to report/project, and the file grew without bound; now the store upserts by (task, harness) with an atomic rewrite, so report always reflects the latest measurement.

body.zh: 默认的 offline run 一直不把 --task 透进去——你 --task swe-bench-mini-001，本想只测这一道，可 offline 路径调 run_benchmark 时没带 task_ids，5 道 canonical 任务全跑了（--task 在 offline 是死选项，v0.2.0 只修了 online 那半）。现在 --task 在 online 和 offline 两条路径都一样穿透：默认 swe-bench-mini 仍是全集，具体 id 只跑那一道；打错 --task 在跑之前就 BadParameter，一分不花。
body.en: The default offline run never threaded --task through — you passed --task swe-bench-mini-001 to measure just that one, but the offline path called run_benchmark with no task filter, so all 5 canonical tasks ran (--task was a dead option in offline mode; v0.2.0 only fixed the online half). Now --task threads through both the online and offline paths identically: the default swe-bench-mini still resolves to the full set, a specific id runs just that one task; a typoed --task surfaces as BadParameter before anything runs, at $0.

body.zh: store 一直是追加写、读取不去重——每跑一遍 envelcost run，profiles.jsonl 就多出一整份重复测量，report 的表和 JSON 里出现 N 份一模一样的行，projector 读到的也是重复行；换个 --harnesses 子集再跑，旧子集的行还混在新行里。现在 store 按 (task, harness) 去重替换、原子重写：重复 run 只刷新、不堆叠，report 永远只反映最新一次测算，文件也不再无限增长。
body.en: The store always wrote in append mode and never de-duplicated on read — every envelcost run added a full duplicate measurement set to profiles.jsonl, so the report table and JSON showed N identical rows and the projector read duplicated rows; re-running with a different --harnesses subset left the old subset's rows mixed in with the new. Now the store upserts by (task, harness) with an atomic rewrite: a repeated run refreshes in place instead of stacking, report always reflects the latest measurement, and the file no longer grows without bound.

title.zh: 投影到你真实的 GPU 座位
title.en: Project it onto your real GPU seats

body.zh: 给定你的 GPU 数和并发座位数，按你测出来的跨 harness 差距，告诉你哪个 harness 撑得住、哪个撑不住、每座多少钱、整柜 capex 多少。换一台机器、换个座位数，重算只需一条命令——envelcost project --gpus 8xH100 --seats 50。
body.en: Give it your GPU count and concurrent seat target, and from the cross-harness gap you measured it tells you which harness fits, which doesn't, the cost per seat, and the rack's total capex. Swap a GPU or a seat count, re-run one command — envelcost project --gpus 8xH100 --seats 50.

chips: › 每座成本 · 整柜 capex

title.zh: 离线 · 可复现 · 数据不出境

body.zh: 核心测算不联网、不要 API key——按实际请求文本离线 tokenize 算出每个 harness 多烧的 token，谁都能复跑出同一张表。可选的 --online 模式用真实 DeepSeek 用量把输出 token 填齐，只为你点名的 (harness, task) 对付费。开源 MIT，自托管免费。
body.en: The core run needs no network and no API key — it tokenizes the actual request text offline to work out the extra tokens each harness burns, so anyone can reproduce the same table. The optional --online mode fills in real DeepSeek output-token usage, billing only the (harness, task) pairs you named. Open source under MIT, free to self-host.

headline.zh: 把跨 harness 的 token 成本差距，算成信创 GPU 集群的容量数字
headline.en: Turn cross-harness token-cost gaps into capacity numbers for on-prem GPU clusters

sub.zh: 开源、MIT、自托管免费。容量测算这一核心动作，永不设墙。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, free to self-host. The core act of sizing your capacity is never gated.

tag.zh: 把跨 harness 的 token 成本差距，算成信创 GPU 集群的容量数字
tag.en: Turning cross-harness token-cost gaps into capacity numbers for on-prem GPU clusters

changelog.zh: v0.5.0 修复了 project 摘要：单 harness store 不再误报 'deepseek-native does NOT fit'（基线现在按 1.0x parity 投影）。--gpus 校验：打错的（H100x8）、0（0xH100）、负数（-2xH100）现在抛干净错误，不再是 traceback 或静默的 0/负 capex 投影。新增 envelcost project --json 机器可读容量投影，对齐 report 已有的 JSON 输出。
changelog.en: v0.5.0 fixes the project summary so a single-harness store no longer falsely reports 'deepseek-native does NOT fit' (it now projects the baseline at 1.0x parity). --gpus validation: a typoed (H100x8), zero (0xH100), or negative (-2xH100) count now raises a clean error instead of a traceback or a silently bogus 0/negative-capex projection. Adds envelcost project --json for machine-readable capacity projection, mirroring the JSON output report already ships.

changelog.zh: m1 方差判定门现在测量真实的跨测试集离散度（而非相对基线的最大值），排除基线的双测试集运行不再会静默放行。--task 逗号列表里匹配不到任何任务的部分现在会明确报错，而不再悄悄只跑子集。
changelog.en: The m1 variance kill gate now measures true cross-harness spread (not max-vs-baseline), so a 2-harness run excluding the baseline can no longer silently hold. A --task comma-list part matching nothing now raises a clear error instead of quietly running a subset.

zh: offline（默认）run 现在尊重 --task——过滤条件透进 run_benchmark，点名哪道任务就只跑哪道；之前 offline 路径不带 task_ids，--task 在 offline 是死选项（v0.2.0 只修了 online 那半）。
store 不再追加重复行——改为按 (task, harness) 去重替换 + 原子重写，重复 envelcost run 只刷新不堆叠，report/project 永远只反映最新一次测算，文件也不再无限增长（v0.2.0 延期的中置信度 bug，现高置信度修复）。
en: The offline (default) run now respects --task — the filter threads into run_benchmark, so naming a task runs only that one; previously the offline path passed no task_ids, making --task a dead option in offline mode (v0.2.0 only fixed the online half).

The store no longer appends duplicate rows — it now upserts by (task, harness) with an atomic rewrite, so a repeated envelcost run refreshes in place instead of stacking, and report/project always reflect the latest measurement with no unbounded file growth (the medium-confidence bug deferred in v0.2.0, now fixed at high confidence).

zh: --online 现在尊重 --harnesses 和 --task——过滤条件穿透进 run_online，只为你选中的 (harness, task) 对走付费 DeepSeek API，不再把整张 5 任务 × 3 envelope 网格计费；--task 在任何付费调用前就被解析校验，打错当场 BadParameter、一分不花。
跨 envelope 的 kill floor 不再被单 harness 运行假性证伪——新增 floor_evaluable 门控：不足 2 个 harness 时跳过 kill gate，退出干净。
en: --online now respects --harnesses and --task — the filter threads into run_online, billing only the (harness, task) pairs you selected through the paid DeepSeek API instead of the full 5-task × 3-envelope grid; --task is resolved and validated before any paid call, so a typo surfaces as BadParameter at $0.
The cross-envelope kill floor is no longer falsely falsified by a single-harness run — a new floor_evaluable gate skips the kill floor when fewer than 2 harnesses ran, exiting clean.
